expectations.reason: TransactionID must not be null as it uniquely identifies each transaction.
TransactionID values must be unique to avoid duplicate transaction records.
AccountOriginID must not be null to identify the source account.
AccountDestinationID must not be null to identify the destination account.
TransactionTypeID must not be null to classify the transaction type.
TransactionTypeID must be one of the known valid types (1, 2, 3, 4).
Amount must not be null as it represents the transaction value.
Amount must be greater than or equal to zero.
TransactionDate should not be null; however, a small null rate is observed.
BranchID must not be null to identify the branch where the transaction occurred.
BranchID values must be greater than zero.
Description should not be null to provide transaction details.
